ICS 77.140.50; 77.140.60; 77.140.70MTD 04New Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPE1.1 This standard covers the requirement of steel including microalloyed steel plates, strips, shapes and sections (angles, tees, beams, channels, etc), flats, bars, etc, for use as hot dip galvanized structural.1.1.1 This steel is suitable for welded, bolted and riveted structures which is used in variety of applications including transmission line towers.1.1.2 Where welding is employed for fabrication and guaranteed-weldability is required, welding procedure should be as specified in IS 9595.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed below contain provisions, which through reference in this text constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
